source: 2013/TSB Vol 13 No 30 - New Female QD Transmission Adapter.pdf
title: Transmission Adapter 90° Female 3/8" Shallow Quick Disconnect
lead: MOC has developed a new adapter for use on various vehicles (Part No. 94788). It is known to fit some GM, Dodge and Chrysler vehicles. This adapter is a 90 degree version of Part No. 94688.
body: This new adapter can be used with either of the Male Quick Disconnect adapters (Part Nos. 94609 and 94682) to perform a Transmission Fluid Flush.
